title: Commission opens formal investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners in the non-alcoholic drinks sector
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 23 Nov 2026 The European Commission has opened a formal antitrust investigation to assess whether Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (‘CCEP') has breached EU competition rules by (i) hindering the cross-border trade of carbonated soft drinks and sports drinks; and (ii) denying certain wholesale customers the possibility to negotiate the procurement of these products on a multi-country basis.
